trigger: Python Path.write_text without explicit encoding in Windows Python 3.12 helper
symptom: Strict UTF-8 decode fails at byte 6075 (0x96) in four-gates-debt-review.json
root_cause: Default Windows code page used for JSON written with ensure_ascii=False; en dash is encoded as Windows-1252 byte 0x96
safe_handling: Preserve original evidence bytes. Convert only separate external copy; prove parsed JSON identity against original and existing UTF-8 Markdown representation. No tests rerun.
corrected_rule: All Python text writes must explicitly specify encoding=utf-8. Strictly decode newly generated text artifacts before packaging. Preserve raw native logs under their declared encoding separately.
